evidence: Cic. Div. 1.125: fierī omnia fātō, ratiō cōgit fatērī (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: Properly what has been spoken, a prophecy (ex fātīs Sibyllīnīs, Cic. Cat. 3.9); then what is ordained. Cicero defines it as the order and chain of causes: ōrdinem seriemque causārum (Div. 1.125, Lewis & Short).

phrases.latin: fierī omnia fātō, ratiō cōgit fatērī
phrases.english: reason compels us to admit that everything happens by fate

sources: Lewis & Short: fatum
